title: Side extension eaves 3.05 m vs existing 2.90 m (18 Rosslyn Avenue, Chingford)
basis: Appeal against enforcement notice, London Borough of Waltham Forest, Inspector decision 18 Feb 2021, upheld on ground (c): extension eaves (3.045-3.055 m) higher than existing eaves (2.900 m) so A.1(d) fails; confirmed Kulah v SSHCLG [2021] EWHC 3028 (Admin), 15 Nov 2021. The judgment does not give width, depth or house form: those inputs are placeholders and do not affect A.1(d).
